v: The token is set on the server by whoever deployed it, as the PACMAN_TOKEN environment variable — this page cannot read its value. If you deployed the server yourself, look for that variable in the environment it was started from (for systemd, the file the unit EnvironmentFile points at); if someone else deployed it, ask them. Remove the variable and restart the server to turn token authentication off.
